messages:
Alex R: Quick kickoff — we should stop treating pin updates as binary. Small label flips (e.g., 'performance' -> 'perf-tune') are causing unnecessary evictions. Idea: add a compact 'pin_signal' set (affinity + signature + risk) to rollout metadata so runtime can decide non-destructively.

Nina K: agree. Proposed fields (strings on wire): affinity: hot|warm|cold, signature: sha256 of canonical {config,tokenizer,vocab}, risk_level: low|med|high, author_note. Keep protobuf additive-only.

Omar V: runtime semantics sketch:
- if compat_break is true => evict immediately + alert.
- else if signature changed and tenant_policy==strict => evict.
- else if only labels changed or risk_level==low => keep existing pin for a soft_window (configurable) and optionally route tiny canary traffic to new signature.
- respect global reclaim flag to force eviction regardless of soft_window.

Nina K: Also add estimated_memory_change (string like '+120MB') so scheduler avoids promoting a warm->hot when cluster memory is tight. If memory delta > threshold, require manual confirmation or wait for capacity.

Alex R: telemetry: emit events signature_change, soft_promote_started, soft_promote_aborted_reclaim. Console should surface author_note, risk_level, and signature diff. Make sure build pipeline can auto-fill signature and a guessed risk_level; authors can override.

schema-bot: Deploy note: adding affinity, signature, risk_level, estimated_memory_change, and compat_break fields to rollout proto in staging. Additive-only.

Omar V: edgecases: tokenizer-only changes are subtle — signature must include tokenizer spec and vocab hash. We'll need a canonicalizer in the model build to compute this reliably. Also define default windows: label-only grace = 4h, soft_window = 24h. Tenants can set stricter policies.

Nina K: action items: Alex -> draft short RFC for pin_signal fields and default thresholds; Omar -> prototype signature canonicalizer in build pipeline; Ops -> add reclaim toggle and emit reclaim_reason in events; DevRel -> note guidance for model authors on how to pick risk_level/author_note.

Alex R: TL;DR: add compact pin metadata (affinity+signature+risk+mem_delta+compat_break), prefer soft promotion for low-risk/label-only changes, tenant strictness and global reclaim override. We want a follow-up RFC with examples and a few runtime pseudo-algos.
